title: Native form first
text: Enhances a plain form element and discovers every AbsoluteUI control inside it, including wrapped native fields.

title: Cross-field rules
text: Rules that read several fields, such as matching emails, run on submit and live after the first attempt.

title: Async validation
text: An optional server check runs after local constraints, with cancellation and a timeout.

title: Error summary
text: A failed submit lists every error as links that move focus to the field.

title: State and server errors
text: Tracks dirty, touched, and submitting state, applies server errors, and resets every control consistently.
